# Ladder7

> Ladder7 NextStep Solutions LLP is a custom software development company in Kochi and Trivandrum, Kerala, India.
> It builds enterprise-grade custom software, web applications, mobile apps, AI assistants and automation at affordable, flexible pricing, and provides dedicated developers
> and offshore teams. Current clients are in the UAE, UK, Germany, Ireland, USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India; it takes on projects across the GCC, Europe and Africa.
> Contact: info@ladder7.in, +91 8137979401. A separate Education division offers IT training and internships in Kerala.

## Products
- [Every ad channel in one marketing analytics view](https://www.ladder7.in/products/infinite-insights): Infinite Insights is an AI-powered marketing analytics platform that unifies Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 into a single dashboard.
- [One view across the systems you already use](https://www.ladder7.in/products/l7-insights): Connect Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, Zoho, SharePoint, SAP or a CSV, and each source becomes a table you can chart in one dashboard.
- [An AI executive team for your business](https://www.ladder7.in/products/l7-nexus): L7 Nexus is a leased AI executive team for businesses of any size. It builds a permanent company brain and puts named executives and specialists to work on it.
- [B2B email written one at a time](https://www.ladder7.in/products/outreach-engine): Outreach Engine is a B2B email outreach platform. It researches each prospect and writes a single email for that person, rather than filling a template.
- [One website audit across twelve lenses](https://www.ladder7.in/products/site-360): Audit your website across twelve lenses — performance, accessibility, SEO, AEO, GEO, AI readiness and security — into one Digital Health score.
